body.content: Approach for improvement: start with a good hand-constructed candidate (e.g., the perturbed grid), then use local optimization. For each point, compute which triangle is the minimum, then perturb that point to increase that triangle's area while not decreasing any other triangle below the current minimum. This hill-climbing approach could push the minimum up incrementally.
body.why_keep_this: This is a concrete next step if hand constructions plateau.
